note: Alberta Parks recreation area on paved Hwy 752, about 30 minutes southwest of Rocky Mountain House, near Prairie Creek: three loops of spacious sites in mature forest. No firewood for sale and limited cell reception. OHV trails are nearby, but OHVs may not be unloaded or ridden in the campground and must stay on trailers until they reach the trail staging areas. Dark-sky stargazing. --Claude
